book.name: KOLOSI
book.title: KOLOSI Pol so mamey, sios Kolosi mon ma lwak se ma mey kow ha hok non

content: Lwayr yor porih o, iwon o
Hme Krais se nion su ma ma-me-sian wayr hokwe, hmo uron mokwe omeme nonkumey mon ma lwak me-aw nan e. Serey mon kokwe Krais hiykwe hyo sia-king mon God so iha sayar mon liwak.
Hmo nanpanan yor mokwe omeme ayaw ko me-aw nanpanan kraiay popriy e, omeme ki erey suko me peie nanpanan o.
Payhokuaw, homkwe po lokrue, sa hmo wa mokwe Krais so kueir nonaw God so mon lwak sue.
Krais hiykwe hmo wa-ar, sa enekwei hiy lousne ankin, hom seyn, hye nion non-ousne nok, hyo panpaniowni se non-swapeykyay onok ok.

Homkwe kyai piap-araw ki erey suko me kwa lokin kwor okrue. Kyai senkin: yokun nweyh kane yor senkin senkin o, yor orki non o, yokun-uron o, lira way yor piap-araw o, ompreir kawk yor o. (Suw senkin, ompreir kawk yor hokwe okrei-god me ma me-ihey yor hok non.)
God so aw-mar hokwe, kyai piap-araw seme hokuaw, ya lousne a, uwrsa hye hyaw ma lwak mo owh mon kokwe.
Hmo liwak yor paraw-uh mokwe mo senkin lwak, seyr homkwe kyai piap-araw sohom mo krai ouon mon lwak.

Sawk enekwei enkin ohokwe, homkwe kyai piap-araw enkin: kasaw lon hohuaw yor o, aw-lwon ma saw-ie o, har me ma mon yorpayor o, me-kawrpakawr ok o, ok-piap-ok hmo woki ko o, somokwe homkwe kwa lokriy ha.
Homkwe hmo wayh-wayh me okrei-ok peie lokin lor-a-lor kow o, payhokuaw, homkwe “uwr nawp” kyai piap-araw non se po kanseyn yay hain,
sawk homkwe uwr iwon se po lie. Uwr iwon sohiy so Monhre-uwr hokwe, mo God hiykiaw-aw, sa hiykwe uwr iwon sohokwe hiykiaw panapan iwon-ar sehe mon wak, hom hye nonkway nuw-wak e.

Sa God so inour mon kokwe hrom lowpwarowp mokwe liy-liy-aw, mo hom uwrkayn irweyk hi, hom Juda hi, mo hom owh-ohi lei mapru hi, hom lei mapru lopa hi, mo hom uwrsa nonkway lopa hi, uwrsa, uwrku Skit ko hi, mo hom uwrsa puraw hi, hom uwrsa liaup-uwr lopa lwak hi, hom lowpwarowp mokwe irweyk irweyk korey. Sawk Krais hiykiaw-aw, hmo lowpwarowp mo peyrmawk ma liarok hokwe, seyr hiykwe hmo lowpwarowp mon lwak.

Homkwe God so uwrsa, hiy ma me-iaup hom non; homkwe pekney-weys, sa hiykwe hme uron-pi ko-ar lwak. Sohiy so hokuaw kokwe, homkwe yor omokwe omeme owh ko me hieyn kwa lie: uron lowk yor o, wayh-wayh me nan ihey yor o, yor, uru lopa se hieyn ma lanio o, kopowrie yor o, lorok kraiar naruok yor o.

Homkwe homkiaw-ayay hohuaw-yor lopa kwa non-wawwaw meio. Seyr homkwe homkiaw-ayay yier-ok lohruw-a ankin, hunkwe hno wayh so yor me kwa lorionay kow ha, Hakamay hiy hno yor piap me ma lorionay kow senkin.
Yor sohom mo eir mon kokwe, homkwe uron-pi ko-ar lwak yor ke kwa nak-meio peykyay. Yor sokukwe hme lowpwarowp me uron kamon-awaw siraw-aw nekie kraipakrai ey.

Hmo uron mon kokwe Krais so liwak marowhway yor hok ka hiy-wayr. Payhokuaw, God hiykwe hme owhi kamon-awaw lwak e sehe me-huonok, hom liwak marowhway yor ko ouon mon lwak e. Sa homkwe God se kar nonaw nak-me-ihey e.

Homkwe Krais so ok kokwe hmo uron mon kokwe ompuay kwa isay yawriy wouk-wouk-ay. Homkwe homkiaw-ayay mawkhow ihey-ar non-aw kwa hiymon sorasor me-kupaku. Homkwe yayh mamey porih ko o, yayh sios ko o, yayh niohney ko o, seme kar nonaw God se kwa lowk.
Hom mey penkin me meio e, ok penkin me lohruw-a e, homkwe Hakamay Jisas so uru nonaw kwa meio, hom hyo kueir nonaw Aio God se nak-me-ihey mokwe.
Hromo liwak yor iwon ko yor yaprue hom non
Sa om, homkwe hmo uwr mo ouon mon kwa lwak, payhokuaw Krais se hokuaw kokwe yor senkin sokukwe yaprue.
Uwr om, homkwe hmo sa me uron-pi ko-ar kwa lwak. Homkwe hmekwe nays-ok peie me o.
Ney om, homkwe enekwei enekwei hmo ipey-aio mo ok me kwa lonuayk me. Payhokuaw, yor sokukwe Hakamay se kar mon ey ey.
Ipey-aio om, homkwe hmo ney me ok meyk lopa non me peie me-hohuaw o, sawk hom ney mo uron me mon piapay lak.

Mey-uwrsa puraw om, homkwe hmo liaup-uwr ki erey suko mo ok lowpwarowp me kwa lonuayk me. Homkwe hmo liaup-uwr, hiy hme ma lira soway-soway sohiy nonaw peie meio o, hiy hme senkin nan e, homkwe mey-uwr yaprue-ar. Sawk hmo mey mokwe homkwe ok-ar yor nonaw, seyr Hakamay se hok-uron nonaw kwa meio.
Hom pay mey me meio e, hunkwe hno uron lowpwarowp non kwa nak-meio. Hno meio yor kokwe, mey, uwrsa me ma meio kow senkin peie meio o, sawk God se ma meio kow, senkin kwa meio.
Homkwe nonkway, homkwe pie, Hakamay hiy hyo uwrsa me kow e ma liaup mokwe, ya lonok a. Payhokuaw, Liaup-uwr-ar hom ma meio kow hokwe, Hakamay Krais hiykiaw.
Seyr uwrsa yor piap-araw me ma mon nakyas mo yor piap mokwe ya ma-sahre nakway a. Payhokuaw, God hiykwe uwrsa lowpwarowp me kokwe meir liy-liy-aw nonaw mesor anon anon.
